findings.message: There are no tests for the new `apple` model. test/basic.js has no assertions for `convert.apple.rgb` or `convert.rgb.apple`, and none for multi-hop routes the router now builds automatically, such as `apple.hsl`, `hsl.apple` and `keyword.apple`. Add round-trip cases (e.g. `rgb.apple([255,255,255]) -> [65535,65535,65535]`, `apple.rgb([65535,32767,0]) -> [255,127,0]`) so the 16-bit scaling and rounding behaviour is locked in.

The new public `apple` model isn't documented. Adding it to the model map exposes `convert.apple.*` and `convert.*.apple` for every model through route.js, but README.md and CHANGELOG.md weren't updated. The name 'apple' also doesn't say that it means 16-bit RGB channels in the range 0–65535 (the AppleScript/NSColor convention). Document the range and meaning so users know what values to pass and what they'll get back.
